The Time Service module shall use the G PT driver service Gpt_GetPredefTimerValue to get the current time value for the desired Predef Timer.
The “ 1us16bit ” functions shall use the Timer GPT_PREDEF_TIMER_1US_16BIT as time base if a time base is needed .
The “ 1us24bit ” functions shall use the Timer GPT_PREDEF_TIMER_1US_24BIT as time base if a time base is needed .
The “ 1us32bit ” functio ns shall use the Timer GPT_PREDEF_TIMER_1US_32BIT as time base if a time base is needed .
The “ 100us32bit ” functions shall use the Timer GPT_PREDEF_TIMER_100US_32BIT as time base if a time base is needed .

The ResetTimer functions shall reset the timer instance passed by the parameter TimerPtr . This means, the reference time of the timer instance shall be set to the current time of the related GPT Predef Timer.
The ResetTim er functions shall be reentrant, if the timer instances used in concurrent calls are different.
The GetTimeSpan functions shall calc ulate and deliver the time difference between the current time and the reference time of the timer instance.
The GetTimeSpan functions shall perform proper wrap - around handling at subtraction (current time - reference time), if value of current time is less than value of reference time .
The GetTimeSpan functions shall be fully reentrant, this means even for the same timer instance.
The ShiftTimer functions shall shift the reference time of the timer instance. This means, the value TimeValue shall be added to the reference time of the timer instance.
The ShiftTimer functions shall perform proper wrap - around handling at adding (reference time + TimeValue), if the sum is greater than the maximum value of the timer.
The ShiftTimer functions with range 24bit shall limit the value of the parameter TimeValue to 0xFFFFFF.

If development error detection for the Time Service module is enabled: I f the value of the parameter TimeValue is greater than 0x FFFFFF , the ShiftTimer functions with range 24bit shall raise the error TM_E_PARAM_VALUE.
The ShiftTimer functions shall be reentrant, if the timer instances used in concurrent calls are different.
The SyncTimer functions shall synchronize two timer instances. This means, the reference time of the destination timer instance shall be set to the reference time of the source timer instance.
The SyncTimer functions shall be reentrant, if the destination timer instances used in concurrent calls are different.
The BusyWait functions shall perform busy waiting for the minimum time passed by the parameter WaitingTimeMin .
The BusyWait functions shall not disable the interrupts. T his means the real waiting time may be greater than t he desired waiting time .
The BusyWait functions shall guarantee the minimum waiting . This means, n+1 ticks must be observed to ensure that an interval of at least n ticks has passed.
The B usyWait functions shall be reentrant.
For each Predef Timer enabled by configuration the following set of API services shall be available: ResetTimer, GetTimeSpan, ShiftTimer, SyncTimer.
For each Predef Timer with tick duration 1µs enabled by configuration t he API service BusyWait shall be available.

A registered notifier via ara::tsync::SynchronizedTimeBaseConsumer:: RegisterSynchronizationStateChangeNotifier shall be invoked, if ara:: tsync::SynchronizationStatus is changed.
A registered notifier via ara::tsync::SynchronizedTimeBaseConsumer:: RegisterTimeLeapNotifier shall be invoked, if ara::tsync::LeapJump is changed.

For Synchronized Time Bases, a registered TimePrecisionMeasurement notifier (via ara::tsync::SynchronizedTimeBaseConsumer::RegisterTimePrecisionMeasurementNotifier) shall write the block elements • glbSeconds • glbNanoSeconds • timeBaseStatus • virtualLocalTimeLow • rateDeviation • locSeconds • locNanoSeconds • pathDelay to the related measurement recording…

For Offset Time Bases, a registered TimePrecisionMeasurement notifier (via ara::tsync::SynchronizedTimeBaseConsumer::RegisterTimePrecisionMeasurementNotifier) shall only write the block elements GlbSeconds, GlbNanoSeconds and TimeBaseStatus to the related measurement recording table.

A registration via ara::tsync::SynchronizedTimeBaseConsumer::RegisterTimePrecisionMeasurementNotifier shall only be possible for Synchronized Time Bases, for which isSystemWideGlobalTimeMaster is set to FALSE.
